༄༅/ /gza' bdud gsang sgrub bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog 'dra/

tei:div.tei:p: rin chen shog 'dra/ gza' bdud rā hu la'i gsang sgrub dug gi spu gri zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku/ /che mchog he ru ka dpal la/ /btud de zab chos rgyab brten du/ /reg chod dug gi spu gri bri/ /'di la rdzas dmigs sngags gnad gsum/ /rdzas ni pha wang long bu yi/ /ngos bzhir tri bzhi ra khrag bris/ / gser gangul zangs lcags gzi rnying dang*/ /bde gshegs ring bsrel bcas pa ni/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas/ /rtsibs la hūṃ bzhi mu khyud la/ /āoṃ badzra tsaṇḍa mahā ro ṣa na hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge mos gza' rgod brtod la non par gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bris lte bar rang ming dang*/ /grub par gyur cig ces pa bri/ /de lta'i 'khor lo bri byas la/ /'khor lo dar nag gril la bcangs/ /des ni 'tshe dogs mi byed cing*/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'brang*/ /de nas brag nag 'jigs pa'i sar/ /phung shul sa blangs 'brub khung bca'/ /rau sol byugs par ling ga ni/ /dgra gzugs dpral bar de yi rus/ /snying gar ming bris g.yas g.yon du/ /ka ta staṃ ste bha ya mu kha taṃ yā/ zhes bris pra tshil gril la gzhug /bshos bu dgu skor nang du yang*/ /ling ga ra khrag bris la gzhug /de nyid 'brub khung steng du gzhag /dmar gtor khrag snas brgyan par bya/ /de la gza' yi gzugs bris gzug /de nas rang nyid skad cig gis/ /ye shes gza' mchog dud kha la/ /dbu dgu g.yas gsum dkar ljang la/ /g.yon gsum dmar ljang dbus ma gsum/ /mthing nag du ba'i rnam pa la/ /spyi gtsug sgra gcan bya rog gdong*/ /phyag bzhi g.yas g.yon dang po na/ /chu srin zhags pa ral gri bsnams/ /'og mas mda' gzhu rgyab tu 'gengs/ /smad sbrul mig gis lus khengs bsgoms/ / thugs ka'i kṣa nag 'od 'phros pas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs ka nas/ /ye shes gza' mchog spyan drangs bstim/

/mdun gyi brub khung nam mkha' la/ /gza' bdud chen po 'jigs pa'i sku/ /nam mkha' gang bar sngar bzhin bsgom/ /chun par dka' na tshon gang bsgom/ /hrī shag ru ram̐ na ga tsitta traṃ/ ma ma yong za/ 'gram ha hi/ yo ge sha la dza dzaḥ/ zer/ de ltar 'bod sngags nyer gnyis kyis/ /rgyu phyogs ye shes spyan drangs bstim/ /dmar gtor ling ga bcas pa de/ /dgra bor bsam la sngags de la/ /bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa btags la dbul bar bya/ / de nas sngags rgod nyer gnyis pa/ /zhag 'dun bar du bzlas par bya/ /de tshe bandhe a tsa ra/ / dngos sam rmi lam nyid du 'ong*/ /thag 'tsheg 'od 'byung sgo brdung sogs/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs ci byung yang*/ /sems yin sems nyid nam mkha' 'dra/ / gdod nas skye med ngang la gzhag /'jigs skrag mi bya bsgom bzlas bya/ /de nas zhag ni bcu bzhi ru/ /dgra bo yod na gsod sngags bzlas/ /āoṃ a kro te ka hrī shag ru raṃ/ ma ma yong za/ 'gram ha he ke sha la che ge mo'i snying la rbad dza dza/ zhes bzlas dgra bo bsad dang gzir/ /rdul phran cha shas tsam med par/ /gza' mchog khros pas zos par bsam/ /de ltar zhag grangs nyer gcig tu/ /lta ba ma yengs sgom bzlas brtson/ /thang lhod med par bsgrim lte bsgrub/ /de yis su yin pha rol sgrol/ /ji ltar 'gor yang zla ba gcig / nges par 'grub par gdon mi za/ /de nas las sbyor bstan pa ni/ /dgu stong nyi ma nub mtshams la/ /rang kha lho nub mtshams bltas la/ /skyer pa se ba gru gsum du/ /'brub khung steng rtsig gza' bskyed la/ /me sbar ling ga sbyin bsreg bya/ /gtor ma dbul zhing gtor zor 'phangs/ /thal ba rgya gram 'og tu mnan/ /gnas de rang gi gzhi yin na/ /sgrub pa thon pa'i shul de ru/ / bong dug thar nu spyang tsher dang*/ /gu gul nag pos 'brub khung bkru/ /rtsi sman sna tshogs bsres pa'i sa/ /rin po che yi bsres byugs la/ /'brub khung nang du bcug la gzhag

/de yis dug phyung bkra shis so/ /gzhan gnas las kyi rjes bsdu'o/ /yang gcig brtod la gnon pa ni/ /sbrul dang ra rog sha khrag dang*/ /nya sha ra tshil pha wang rdo/ /rta nag ra nag khyi nag gi /snying khrag dkar gsum rtsi sman bcas/ /rta nag thod pa'i nang du gzhug /rta thod maṇḍal gra ru gzhag /des ni brtod la non par 'gyur/ /yang cig shi sa bstan pa ni/ /āoṃ badzra tsaṇḍa mahā to ṣa na hūṃ phaṭa/ na te pa ti kha dza ke beng ru ru gyi mi sha ya āoṃ/ myags thum ril rbad yā/ rang srog rang gis gcod pa'i tshul/ /las rnams 'grub par the tshom med/ /skabs su bzlas pas myur du 'grub/ /yang cig zhud kha blang ba ni/ /zhud de rtags med dam nyams na/ /bskang bshags mchod pa dag gis mchod/ /'o ma rtsi sman gu gul dkar/ /ra mchin til nag phud kyis mchod/ /des ni myur du 'grub pa yin/ /'jig rten mchod cing bstod pas 'grub/ /de phyir bskang gso mchod gtor ni/ /dus gnyen brgyad dang rgyun du bya/ khyad par nyi shu dgu la 'o/ /des ni the tshom med par 'grub/ /rgyal sras padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /phyogs bzhi'i zab gter chen po bzhi/ /yang zab gza' yi gsang sgrub sbas/ /de dag kun gyi yang zab gnad/ /chig dril dug gi spu gri ni/ dri med 'od zer bdag gis bkod/ /phyi rabs bstan pa bsrung bar shog /ji ltar bdag gis sgrub pa yi/ /gnad rnams bcud kyi snying po dril/ /'di bas zab pa gzhan med pas/ /gsang zhing sba bas bcang bar bya/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag 'dis/ /bdag gi zab gter bsrung bar shog /gza' bdud rā hu la'i gsang sgrub/ /dug gi spu gri zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon padmas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ /ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)gza' bdud gsang sgrub/
